# Fold POS

> Point of sale and operations software for laundromats, dry cleaners and tailors, built by Fold Laundry. Fold POS rings up wash & fold by the pound, dry cleaning by the piece and alterations by the task on one counter, then follows every order from drop-off to pickup — with machines, supplies, pickup & delivery routes, marketing, staff shifts and printing in the same screen. Plans are $79, $149 and $249 a month (USD), month-to-month, with a 14-day free trial and no card up front. Shops anywhere in the Americas except Cuba can sign up; the counter, Hey Fold and customer texts work in English and Spanish, and the whole site is also in Spanish at https://foldpos.com/es/.

Fold POS runs in a browser, as a Mac or Windows app, or on an iPad, and prints to the Epson, Bixolon, Star and Zebra printers a shop already owns. "Hey Fold", a voice assistant that takes an order by speech and sends it to the printer, is built into every plan. Markdown mirrors of each page are linked below; each HTML page also declares its mirror with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`.

## Product

- [Fold POS home](https://foldpos.com/fold-pos.md): What Fold POS is, who it is for, and every part of it in one page — counter, orders board, floor map, delivery, back office, pricing.
- [Hey Fold](https://foldpos.com/hey-fold.md): The voice assistant in every plan: how to call it, what to say, how it confirms before anything prints, English and Spanish.
- [Pickup & delivery](https://foldpos.com/pickup-delivery.md): Today's runs, routes on a map, the Fold Driver app, Uber Direct couriers, customers booking their own pickup online, status texts and cost per stop; on Growth and Pro.
- [Money at the counter](https://foldpos.com/counter-money.md): Refunds with an owner code, the cash drawer with X and Z reports, sales tax the owner sets, and taking new orders offline; on every plan.
- [Plants & drop stores](https://foldpos.com/plants.md): Linking a dry cleaning plant and its drop stores, bags scanned at every hand-off, piece counts, alerts, plant rates and the monthly statement.
- [All features](https://foldpos.com/features.md): The nine feature areas in depth — counter, workflow board, ticket, machine management, floor plan, supplies, marketing, pickup & delivery, staff & shifts.
- [Pricing](https://foldpos.com/pricing.md): Starter $79, Growth $149 and Pro $249 a month, what each plan includes, the 14-day free trial, and payments on the shop's own processor.
- [FAQ](https://foldpos.com/faq.md): Getting started, pricing and the trial, printers and the print helper, switching from Cents or CleanCloud, payments, Hey Fold, pickup & delivery, and how Fold POS relates to Fold.
- [Help center](https://foldpos.com/help.md): Short how-tos: set up a store, connect a printer, import data, use Hey Fold, add staff, customer texts, delivery, connect an AI assistant, plan & billing.
- [Connect an AI assistant to your store](https://foldpos.com/assistants.md): How a store owner connects their own AI assistant, such as Claude, to one store: what it can look at, the three small changes it can make only if the owner allows them, what it cannot do, pausing and removing, the activity list, and what to do if someone else got in.
- [About](https://foldpos.com/about.md): Why Fold Laundry built Fold POS, and what it cares about.

## By shop type

- [For laundromats](https://foldpos.com/laundromats.md): Wash & fold by the pound, a live floor map of every washer and dryer, machine and vending stock, delivery routes.
- [For dry cleaners](https://foldpos.com/dry-cleaners.md): Per-piece tickets, heat-seal garment tags, conveyor slots, alterations on the same ticket, wash & fold and pickup & delivery.
- [For tailors and alterations shops](https://foldpos.com/alterations.md): Per-task pricing, measurements, photos and notes on every ticket, due-date reminders, and none of the laundry screens.

## Getting started

- [Store setup guide](https://foldpos.com/setup.md): Seven short steps to open a shop on Fold POS — account, browser, price list import, printer, staff, customer texts, first order.
- [Printers](https://foldpos.com/printers.md): Supported receipt and tag printers (Epson, Star, Bixolon, Zebra), barcode scanners, and how each browser connects.
- [Fold print helper](https://foldpos.com/download.md): The small Windows program that lets any browser print receipts and garment tags, and how to pair it with a six-digit code.
- [Sign up](https://pos.foldpos.com/signup): Start the 14-day free trial; no card up front.
- [Log in](https://pos.foldpos.com/login): The Fold POS app itself.

## For developers and agents

- [Developers & AI](https://foldpos.com/developers.md): The markdown mirrors, and three MCP servers. Product facts, public and read-only: https://app.foldpos.com/v1/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no auth). A store's own records, for the store owner's own AI assistant: https://app.foldpos.com/v1/mcp/store (the owner signs in and approves inside Fold POS, or uses a personal token; look-only unless the owner switches on three small changes). Pickup booking, for a customer's own AI assistant: https://app.foldpos.com/v1/mcp/book (no sign-in; the customer confirms with a code texted to their phone; nothing is charged at booking).
- [MCP server card](https://foldpos.com/.well-known/mcp.json): Machine-readable description of the MCP servers: endpoints, transport, authorization and tools.
- [llms-full.txt](https://foldpos.com/llms-full.txt): The whole site's readable content as one markdown document.

## Contact

- [Contact page](https://foldpos.com/contact.md): Demos, switching from another system, store support, partners and the API.
- [Email Fold POS](mailto:contact@foldpos.com): Questions, a demo, migration help, or access to the private store-owner API. (A store owner's own AI assistant does not need that API: it connects at https://app.foldpos.com/v1/mcp/store.)

## En español

Fold POS en español, para tiendas de todo el continente americano. Los precios son en dólares estadounidenses (USD).

- [Inicio](https://foldpos.com/es/fold-pos.md): Qué es Fold POS, para quién es y cada parte en una sola página.
- [Hey Fold](https://foldpos.com/es/hey-fold.md): El asistente de voz de todos los planes: cómo llamarlo, qué decirle y cómo confirma antes de imprimir.
- [Recogida y entrega](https://foldpos.com/es/pickup-delivery.md): Rutas, la app Fold Driver, mensajeros de Uber Direct, reservas en línea y mensajes de estado; en Growth y Pro.
- [El dinero en el mostrador](https://foldpos.com/es/counter-money.md): Reembolsos con código del propietario, caja con reportes X y Z, impuesto sobre las ventas y pedidos nuevos sin conexión.
- [Plantas y tiendas de recepción](https://foldpos.com/es/plants.md): Vincular una planta con sus tiendas de recepción, bolsas escaneadas en cada entrega, conteo de piezas, alertas, tarifas y estado de cuenta mensual.
- [Todas las funciones](https://foldpos.com/es/features.md): Las nueve áreas de funciones en detalle.
- [Precios](https://foldpos.com/es/pricing.md): Starter $79, Growth $149 y Pro $249 al mes (USD), la prueba gratis de 14 días y los pagos con su propio procesador.
- [Preguntas frecuentes](https://foldpos.com/es/faq.md): Primeros pasos, uso fuera de Estados Unidos, precios, impresoras, cambio de sistema, pagos, Hey Fold y entregas.
- [Centro de ayuda](https://foldpos.com/es/help.md): Guías cortas para configurar la tienda, conectar una impresora, importar datos y más.
- [Conecte un asistente de IA a su tienda](https://foldpos.com/es/assistants.md): Cómo conecta el propietario su propio asistente de IA, como Claude, a una tienda: qué puede mirar, los tres cambios pequeños que hace solo si el propietario los permite, qué no puede hacer, cómo pausarlo o quitarlo y la lista de actividad.
- [Para lavanderías](https://foldpos.com/es/laundromats.md): Lavado y doblado por libra, el plano del local y las máquinas.
- [Para tintorerías](https://foldpos.com/es/dry-cleaners.md): Tickets por prenda, etiquetas termoadhesivas y lugares en el transportador.
- [Para sastrerías](https://foldpos.com/es/alterations.md): Precio por trabajo, medidas, fotos y pruebas.
- [Impresoras](https://foldpos.com/es/printers.md): Impresoras de recibos y etiquetas compatibles (Epson, Star, Bixolon, Zebra).
- [Asistente de impresión](https://foldpos.com/es/download.md): El pequeño programa para Windows que imprime recibos y etiquetas desde cualquier navegador.
- [Desarrolladores e IA](https://foldpos.com/es/developers.md): Los espejos en markdown y tres servidores MCP: el público con datos del producto (https://app.foldpos.com/v1/mcp), el de la tienda para el asistente de IA del propietario (https://app.foldpos.com/v1/mcp/store, con inicio de sesión o token) y el de reservas de recogida para el asistente de un cliente (https://app.foldpos.com/v1/mcp/book, sin inicio de sesión; el cliente confirma con un código que recibe por mensaje de texto).
- [Contacto](https://foldpos.com/es/contact.md): Demostraciones, cambio de sistema, soporte y socios.
- [Nosotros](https://foldpos.com/es/about.md): Por qué Fold Laundry creó Fold POS.
